en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a garden or yard bordered by a picket fence, with two multi‑story wooden buildings in the background that look like early 20th‑century Scandinavian houses. In the foreground stand three women in period clothing and hats among bushes and trees. At the top left is printed text identifying the place, and at the bottom right a reference number is printed.
